queries.sql: create table if not exists projects(id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,repo_name varchar(255) not null unique,current_stars integer,current_forks integer,current_watchers integer,last_pushed_at timestamp(6) with time zone,last_polled_at timestamp(6) with time zone)

create table if not exists star_history(id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,project_id bigint not null references projects(id),star_count integer not null,recorded_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null)
SELECT SETTING_VALUE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SETTINGS WHERE SETTING_NAME=?
select p1_0.id,p1_0.current_forks,p1_0.current_stars,p1_0.current_watchers,p1_0.last_polled_at,p1_0.last_pushed_at,p1_0.repo_name from projects p1_0 where p1_0.repo_name=?
select sh1_0.star_count from star_history sh1_0 where sh1_0.project_id=? order by sh1_0.recorded_at desc,sh1_0.id desc fetch first ? rows only

select p1_0.id,p1_0.current_forks,p1_0.current_stars,p1_0.current_watchers,p1_0.last_polled_at,p1_0.last_pushed_at,p1_0.repo_name from projects p1_0 where p1_0.repo_name in (?,?,?) order by p1_0.repo_name

select sh1_0.id,sh1_0.project_id,p1_0.id,p1_0.current_forks,p1_0.current_stars,p1_0.current_watchers,p1_0.last_polled_at,p1_0.last_pushed_at,p1_0.repo_name,sh1_0.recorded_at,sh1_0.star_count from star_history sh1_0 join projects p1_0 on p1_0.id=sh1_0.project_id where p1_0.id in (?,?,?) order by sh1_0.recorded_at,sh1_0.id
